notices.short_title: Speciation & drug resistance testing for all samples
notices.description: Health Research Incorporated (HRI), who is designated as a research institute and membership corporation affiliated with the NYS Department of Health (NYS DOH), will provide DOHMH with support, supplement or extend the functions and programs of NYS DOH, for speciation & drug resistance testing. Under this sole source contract, the NYS DOH Wadsworth Center, Mycobacteriology Laboratory will perform Tuberculosis (TB) molecular testing services, including deletion analysis, targeted next generation sequencing (tNGS), and whole genome sequencing (WGS) to perform to ensure rapid, accurate, and comprehensive TB diagnostic and genotyping capacity.
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded Health Research Inc a $73,071 sole source contract, without competitive bidding, for tuberculosis drug resistance and molecular testing performed through the state Department of Health's Wadsworth Center.

notices.short_title: Electrical System Replacement - 156 South 9th Street, Brooklyn
notices.description:
NYC Department of Housing Preservation & Development ('HPD') is responsible to install and repair electrical systems to ensure essential services. HPD has neither sufficient staff with the requisite expertise, nor the equipment necessary to perform this type of work. Qualified bidders must have three years' experience performing this type of work.

Prospective bidders are encouraged to engage with this procurement, access solicitation documents and submit bids through PASSPort: http://www.nyc.gov/BusinessOpportunities (search for '156 S 9 St BK'). Delivery of original bid security may be required as instructed in PASSPort.
notices.plain: The Department of Housing Preservation and Development is seeking bids, due Dec. 2, 2026, for an electrical system replacement at 156 South 9th Street in Brooklyn, with the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: Non-Exclusive Use of City-Owned Trademarks on Merchandise
notices.description:
NYC Tourism + Conventions, Inc., on behalf of the New York City Department of Small Business Services (SBS), has awarded a Sole Source License Agreement (License), pursuant to Section 1-16 of the Concession Rules of the City of New York, to Ten Three Graphics, LLC (Licensee), whose address is 26 Great Pond Rd, South Glastonbury, CT 06073, for the non-exclusive use of City-owned trademarks on merchandise.

The Agreement shall commence January 1, 2026, and continue through December 31, 2028, unless sooner terminated pursuant to the terms and conditions of the License.

During the initial term, Licensee shall pay to NYC Tourism + Conventions a royalty equal to fifteen percent (15%) of Net Sales when sold at Retail, as well as a one-time guaranteed minimum royalty of thirty thousand dollars ($30,000), payable on or before December 31, 2028.

The City, in its sole discretion, shall have the option to renew the License Agreement on substantially the same terms and conditions for a period of two (2) additional years, from January 1, 2029 through December 31, 2030.
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services awarded Ten Three Graphics, LLC, a Connecticut company, a sole-source license to use city-owned trademarks on merchandise for 2026 through 2028, with a $30,000 guaranteed minimum royalty and a 15% royalty on retail sales.

watching.short_title: New York City Environmental Control Board Meeting December 3, 2026
watching.description: The New York City Environmental Control Board (Board) meeting scheduled for Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 9:30 A.M., will be accessible both in person and remotely. The meeting will be held in person at the Office of Administrative Trials and Hearings (OATH), 100 Church Street, 12th Floor, multipurpose training room.  Members of the public may alternatively view the Board meeting electronically by connecting through Webex with meeting number (access code) 2347 913 6932 and password PYdriTt7t65. Minutes of the Board meeting will be transcribed and posted on the OATH website.
watching.plain: The New York City Environmental Control Board will hold a public meeting on Dec. 3, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. at 100 Church Street in Manhattan, with a remote option via Webex.
